findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/coown/CoOwnCandleChart.tsx — chart-type control exists but was a generic `options-outline` gear icon that opened a hidden popover menu (Line/Candlestick/Area). Undiscoverable in first scan; glyph did not communicate chart type.
findings.competitorEvidence: TradingView mobile: chart-type icon in a visible toolbar shows the CURRENT chart glyph. Binance: inline icon row above chart. Coinbase Advanced: segmented line/candles control. Questrade Edge / TradeRevolution mobile: Line/Candle/Area toolbar switcher is the standard mobile set.
findings.rootCause: Switcher designed as settings affordance; user expects a visible segmented control per broker convention.
findings.fix: Replaced gear+popover with ChartTypeSegments — one bordered group with hairline dividers, custom SVG glyphs (line polyline, two-candle OHLC, area fill), active = brandSubtle fill + brand glyph, inactive = textSecondary. tablist/tab a11y + selection haptics.
findings.acceptance: Chart type control visible in header row without opening a menu; type switches on single tap; a11y labels per segment; tests green.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; 9-suite vitest batch green (269 tests)

findings.evidence: CoOwnOrderBook.tsx — depth bars rendered at ~4-6% effective opacity and were per-level-size scaled (no classic cumulative fan); no bid/ask imbalance signal; card title 'Market depth' mislabelled the ladder tab; embedded book could blend into canvas.
findings.competitorEvidence: Binance: dedicated book panel, red ask/green bid rows with visible cumulative depth fills, spread band, B/S imbalance %. Kraken/Coinbase Advanced share the grammar.
findings.rootCause: Depth fills under-powered; panel chrome too weak to read as a dedicated terminal box.
findings.fix: Cumulative-fan depth bars (cumulative/maxCumulative, mirrored anchors: bids left / asks right) at full token strength; semantic coownUp/coownDown prices; recessed spread band (surface inside the surfaceAlt card); B/S imbalance strip with percentage labels + a11y summary; card retitled 'Order book' with Book|Depth|Trades tabs on surfaceAlt + full-strength border; dead maxSize/isEdge removed.
findings.acceptance: Bid/ask sides read green/red at glance; depth fan visible; dedicated panel boundary obvious in both themes; tape tab a11y labels preserved.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; orderBookDepth + runtime suites green

findings.evidence: EditGroupMediaSection — centred avatar with stacked 'Change photo'/'Remove photo'/'Change cover'/'Remove' text actions under a 200px cover block read as assembled scaffold (symmetry-by-default, duplicate affordances). The media sheet already offers change/remove; the text actions duplicated it.
findings.competitorEvidence: WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord group edit: media object is the tap target (camera badge); action sheet owns camera/gallery/remove. No redundant text buttons.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate action chrome instead of single clear affordances.
findings.fix: Removed both text-action stacks + dead props/styles/imports; avatar now straddles the cover's bottom edge (-64 margin netting ~40px overlap) with a 4px background ring — the authored identity-stack composition. Media sheet owns Camera/Gallery/presets/Remove. GroupInfoHero got the same ring for parity + meta-line restraint (no brand-bold count) + singular/plural member/agent counts.
findings.acceptance: One edit affordance per media object; remove lives in media sheet; no visual duplication; overlap reads as intentional layering.

findings.evidence: TradeScreen buy/sell selector was a neutral AppSegmentControl (surfaceAlt track, surface indicator, no direction colour) and the 'Review order' CTA was neutral brand — the only surface in the terminal with no green/red grammar.
findings.competitorEvidence: Binance/Coinbase Advanced/Kraken tickets: buy segment green, sell segment red, direction-coloured submit CTA — the strongest convention in mobile trading for money-direction safety.
findings.rootCause: Generic segment primitive used without direction semantics.
findings.fix: AppSegmentControl extended with per-option activeBackgroundColor (spring indicator now cross-fades colour via shared value + withTiming) and activeTextColor. TradeScreen maps buy→coownUpSubtle/coownUp, sell→coownDownSubtle/coownDown. CTA retitled 'Review buy/sell order' and direction-tinted (coownUp/coownDown fill, colors.background text — reads on both light-pastel dark tokens and deep light tokens).
findings.acceptance: Direction legible at a glance on the ticket; not colour-only (labels explicit); animated indicator transitions colour.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; coown contract suites green

findings.evidence: OrderHistoryRow marked buy/sell with wallet/cash icons in brand/textSecondary — no direction grammar at all; SyndicateOrderHistoryScreen Buy/Sell filter tabs selected in neutral textPrimary; MarketLedgerScreen rows had no side accent.
findings.competitorEvidence: Kraken order history: green up-arrow buy / red down-arrow sell. Binance: coloured Buy/Sell text tags.
findings.rootCause: Side semantics never carried into history surfaces.
findings.fix: OrderHistoryRow: arrow-up/arrow-down direction glyphs + coownUp/coownDown side colours + semibold direction-coloured side word in the meta line (word stays explicit — not colour-only). Filter tabs: buy selects in coownUp, sell in coownDown, All neutral. MarketActivityRow gained optional titleColor; MarketLedgerScreen passes direction accent for buy/sell rows (auction rows neutral).
findings.acceptance: Buy/sell readable by colour + glyph + word across book, ticket, history and ledger — one consistent grammar.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; 7-suite coown batch green (115 tests)

findings.evidence: GroupDetailsStage — flat cover→avatar vertical stack with TWO different remove affordances (X badge on cover, danger-text link under avatar) while GroupMediaSourceSheet received no canRemove/onRemove. Same scaffold pattern as EditGroup.
findings.competitorEvidence: WhatsApp/Telegram group creation: cover+avatar overlap composition, media object is the tap target, removal lives in the source sheet.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate remove paths and disconnected media composition.
findings.fix: Cover/avatar now overlap with background ring (same grammar as EditGroup); both inline remove controls deleted; sheet receives canRemove/onRemove so removal is centralized; dead styles removed from createGroupChatStyles.
findings.acceptance: One edit affordance per media object; remove only in sheet; overlap composition matches EditGroup/GroupInfoHero.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; groupChatInfoParity + coownAssetDetailRuntime suites green

findings.evidence: TradeConfirmScreen — the final commit action (HoldToSubmitButton) rendered neutral colors.brand for both buy and sell. Every upstream surface had direction color; the last, highest-stakes action did not.
findings.competitorEvidence: Binance/Coinbase Advanced confirm sheet: direction-colored commit button — a money action is never color-ambiguous at the commit step.
findings.rootCause: HoldToSubmitButton had no accent override; direction grammar stopped one step short of commit.
findings.fix: HoldToSubmitButton gained optional accentColor (default colors.brand — all other callers unchanged); TradeConfirmScreen passes coownUp/coownDown by side. Receipt side pill was already direction-tinted.
findings.acceptance: Buy commit is green, sell commit is red; disabled/expired states unchanged; a11y label still carries explicit direction word.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; tradeSubmitFlows + orderLifecycleContracts suites green

findings.evidence: CoOwnPositionCard 'Buy more'/'Sell' action buttons were neutral (background fill, border, textPrimary) — the only remaining direction-less money actions in the terminal.
findings.competitorEvidence: Kalshi/Binance position rows: direction-tinted secondary actions — subtle fill + direction label, not solid fills (repeated rows stay quiet).
findings.rootCause: Direction grammar never applied to position-level actions.
findings.fix: Buy more: coownUpSubtle fill + coownUpBorder hairline + coownUp label. Sell: coownDownSubtle fill + coownDownBorder + coownDown label. Disabled/no-sellable states fall back to neutral border + textMuted label.
findings.acceptance: Direction readable on secondary actions without shouting; disabled states stay honest; 44pt targets preserved.
findings.verified: tsc --noEmit clean; coownAssetDetailRuntime suite green (60 tests)

findings.evidence: frontend/src/screens/OrderReceiptScreen.tsx — total and status had no typographic rank (same body size as labels), real delivery facts (destination/service/carrier/ETA/ship-by/delivered date) existed on the contract but were unrendered, refresh control was absent, duplicate section heading, dead ActivityIndicator/t imports.
findings.fix: Status stamp (dot + semantic tone), headline-rank total with hairline fee separator, delivery section renders whenever any real delivery fact exists, contextual next-step copy, refresh wired to refetch, dead imports removed.

findings.evidence: InboxConversationRow shipped with TypingDots, commerceStatusLabel/Tone, contextThumbUri, deliveryStatus props — but InboxRow never passed them. chat.typing.update events arrived on already-subscribed conversation topics and were dropped. Request rows showed literal placeholder "About a listing".
findings.fix: realtimeClient.ts: module-level conversation→typing map + useInboxTypingEvents (reuses useInboxMessageEvent topic set, zero extra subscriptions, self-filter, 4s auto-clear, empty-map pruning) + useConversationTyping via useSyncExternalStore. InboxRow: isTyping, deriveInboxCommerceBadge(conversation.context), contextThumbUri from context.listing.imageUrl, real listing title via useBackendData for request rows.
findings.verified: tsc clean; new inboxCommerceBadge.test.ts (6 tests) green; 108-test batch green

findings.evidence: OrderRowSkeleton rendered 64x64 thumb + 3 text lines + generic 56x24 block while real OrderLedgerRow is 80x100 media + status pill + meta line — visible geometry snap on load.
findings.fix: Skeleton now mirrors real geometry: 80x100 Radius.md media, title line, meta row with 64x22 pill + context line, chevron stub.
findings.verified: tsc clean; seller-net row item skipped — Order contract carries no net/payout field, deriving it client-side would fabricate money data

findings.evidence: ChatTopBar gave group placeholders a deterministic colorForId tint but DM placeholders fell back to flat surfaceAlt — same user reads a different identity color in inbox vs thread header.
findings.fix: groupId prop generalized to avatarSeedId; ChatScreen passes resolvedPartnerId for DMs, GroupChatScreen passes groupId — deterministic color + inverse initials for both variants.

findings.evidence: ItemDetailPriceMarket disclosure row already names the section; the expanded CommerceDetailSection carried a dead required label prop ("Price history & market") — duplicated-heading risk and dead API weight. Same dead label in ItemDetailBuyingSection.
findings.fix: CommerceDetailSection.label made optional; header renders only when label/trailing present; dead labels dropped at both call sites.

findings.evidence: Audit F06 confirmed: UnifiedDiscoveryScreen hardcoded hasMore={false} and refresh called discovery.load() without reaching PinterestMasonryGrid's RefreshControl — pagination and pull-down contracts existed but were unwired.
findings.fix: UnifiedDiscoveryScreen: refreshing state + RefreshControl wired to discovery.load; feed.hasMore/isLoadingMore/onEndReached threaded through DiscoveryFeedView to the grid.

findings.evidence: Audit F07 confirmed: useSettingsScreenData set walletBalance=0 on query failure and SettingsBalanceCard rendered ?? 0 — a failed/loading balance displayed and announced as literal £0.00.
findings.fix: walletBalanceFailed flag added; card renders em-dash while loading, 'Unavailable' + retry hint on failure, formatted GBP only for a real number; a11y label matches.

findings.evidence: Audit F08 confirmed: danger/success/warning served as both deep fills (paired with onX text) and text/icon foregrounds — warning ~2.1:1, danger ~3.8:1 on dark surfaces.
findings.fix: New dangerText/successText/warningText tokens in both palettes. 923 foreground usages migrated; fill contexts (backgroundColor/fill/bar/borderColor) untouched. ThemeColors typing extended.

findings.evidence: Audit F09/F10 confirmed: 'best' performer painted green-up even at -5% (direction from rank not return); formatPositionStatus inferred Open/Closed from isOpen+availableUnits — paused/closed mislabeled.
findings.fix: Direction from signed percentReturn; formatPositionStatus uses authoritative VM p.status.

findings.evidence: Audit F11 confirmed: single ternary colored all connection states — agents-with-zero-connections looked identical to a hard outage; no degraded semantics.
findings.fix: Distinct states: none/neutral, no-agents-with-connections/warning, agents-zero-connections/warning+subtitle, healthy/success, degraded/danger. New i18n keys (en + per-key fallback).

findings.evidence: Audit F12 confirmed: order-book values clipped at numberOfLines={1} inside fixed 104pt rails at large text sizes.
findings.fix: Values/headers wrap to 2 lines inside fixed rails; prospectus numeric cells fontScale-capped 1.2-1.3 + 2-line wrap.

findings.evidence: Audit F13 confirmed: expansion gated on char count >120 while truncation is numberOfLines={3} — dead 'Read more' on short wrapping text, hidden content on long non-wrapping text.
findings.fix: Hidden full-measure Text reports rendered lines via onTextLayout; expansion gates on real overflow.

findings.evidence: Audit F14 confirmed: store.logout() never touched queryClient — private caches survived account switch; prefix-only purge missed keys.
findings.fix: clearUserScopedQueryCache now cancelQueries + queryClient.clear() fail-closed; logout() owns the purge.

findings.evidence: Audit F19 confirmed: EXPO_PUBLIC_MOCK_MODE=fixture-design resolved regardless of __DEV__ — misconfigured prod build renders mock data.
findings.fix: resolveMockMode fails closed: fixture/integration only when __DEV__; production always resolves 'production'.

findings.evidence: Audit F03 confirmed: checker grouped all .sql by prefix — every valid NNN_x.sql + NNN_x_down.sql pair flagged duplicate (32 rollback files exist).
findings.fix: Forward vs _down.sql partitioned; duplicate detection on forward only; orphan rollback warned.
findings.verified: checker exits 0; warnings only for known pre-existing dup prefixes 289/302

findings.evidence: Audit F20: profile closet rendered unbounded masonry in nested scroll. F21: module failures folded into empty rows — partial outage masqueraded as empty discovery.
findings.fix: ClosetGrid caps preview at 12 (View-all -> MyListings); reorder mode keeps full list. staleModules tracked -> quiet 'pull to retry' note in feed header.
